-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Use null for no after-context. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Use null for no before-context. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-C.description: Alias for context. Use null when not needed.

-i.description: Case insensitive search (rg -i). Use null for the default false behavior.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Use null for the default true behavior. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.go", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob. Use null for no glob filter.

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Use null for the current working directory.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. Use null for all file types.

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Use null for the default 0 behavior.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Use null for no context. Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Use null for the default false behavior.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes. Use null for the default 250 behavior. Pass 0 for unlimited.

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines, "files_with_matches" shows file paths, "count" shows match counts. Use null for the default "files_with_matches" behavior.
